lines.text: Clinic shift ended an hour ago. Don't make me look at anything.
Truce. I patch your kind on Tuesdays. Tonight I'm drinking.
Vantongeren's? Keep that lease paper dry. The Row is wet.
We sit by the window so the Row can see we're fine. We are fine.

barks.text: Upstairs closes when the last of us remembers the Stair.
